about: Hand-curated venue research for the Electricity & Energy convention, keyed by the codes its programme-pdf adapter gives the three hotels its frame programme names, with the halls it names in each. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

herods-boutique.name: Herods Boutique Eilat
herods-boutique.notes: The convention's main hotel: the plenaries meet in Kings AB, and the exhibition fills the pavilion and the Kings lobby (the frame programme).

herods-palace.name: Herods Palace Eilat
herods-palace.notes: Next door to Herods Boutique; one of the two on-site registration desks (the registration page).

dan-eilat.name: Dan Eilat
dan-eilat.notes: The second conference hotel, a short walk along the promenade from the Herods hotels; the programme spells one hall both Tarshis and Tarshish, served here as Tarshish.
